snippet.title: Victor's Video Vault - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
It's 1995. The video store is alive. When the last customer leaves, the final rental rewrites reality.

Victor's Video Vault is a horror game being developed for PC and Console platforms. 

Please visit Steam to Wishlist today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4465580/Victors_Video_Vault

For more information please join the game's Discord server, visit our website and follow us on Twitter:

https://discord.gg/Bcs3cvazU3

https://www.stingbotgames.com/victorsvideovault

https://x.com/StingbotGames
@StingbotGames

Music by Brightbone - https://www.youtube.com/@BrightboneMusic
